Actual public generation validates scalar parameters first, private geometry accepts immutable recipe; no demonstrated bypassed invalid production geometry. Parameters contain per-topology irrelevant knobs: FusedBell bypasses free-petal cup/notch/ripple/base-color-boundary/stamen-count branches, whereas RayAndDisk differs in low-detail topology from FreePetals. Payload-owning corolla-specific parameters can avoid silently ignored authoring fields without deleting meaningful topology. Seed phase is angular cyclic, not UnitInterval; petal cup signed and width/height ratios can exceed1, no universal fraction. Sampling fractions constructed from bounded nonzero counts/native LOD preserve role; sampled original ordinal differs from reduced mesh ordinal.

Keep native kernel math raw at actual math adapter rather than proliferating per-coordinate wrappers. Reuse canonical Pigment/PlantLod; no arbitrary tightened botany dimensions or randomized scalar bounds.
